source: live calls against the official Kalshi public REST API, run from a kalshi.com page context
auth: none required for market data reads
cors: api.elections.kalshi.com allows fetch from a kalshi.com origin but NOT from arbitrary origins (example.com fetch failed). Server-side clients are unaffected.

CORRECTION_NOTICE.what_i_got_wrong: An earlier pass in this session concluded Kalshi has no PGA Tour outright winner market. That was WRONG. The winner market exists: KXPGATOUR-ROC26.
CORRECTION_NOTICE.root_cause: The discovery sweep fired ~112 concurrent /events requests. Kalshi rate-limited them: 99 of 112 returned HTTP 429. The code read responses as `(r.events || [])` inside a `catch(e){}`, so rate-limited series silently yielded 'no events' instead of raising. Absence of data was reported as evidence of absence.
CORRECTION_NOTICE.compounding_error: The follow-up 'independent verification' used the same broken sweep, so it reproduced the same false negative and made the wrong conclusion look confirmed.
CORRECTION_NOTICE.how_it_was_caught: Reading the actual kalshi.com golf category page, which links to /markets/kxpgatour/pga-tour/kxpgatour-roc26.
CORRECTION_NOTICE.lesson_for_the_scraper: Never swallow non-200s. Check response.ok explicitly, throttle to small concurrency, and retry on 429.

rate_limits_observed.safe_pattern: small sequential batches with backoff; single-event reads never rate-limited
rate_limits_observed.browser_caveat: setTimeout is throttled to ~1/min in a background tab, so sleep-based pacing stalls when driving this from a non-focused browser tab. Pace server-side instead.

endpoints_verified.markets_by_event: /markets?event_ticker=<TICKER>&limit=500  -> one market per golfer; paginate via `cursor`

winner_market.overround_note: 16% overround on the winner book. Comparable to or tighter than a typical sportsbook golf outright, which often runs 20-40%.
winner_market.price_granularity: sub-cent -- observed 0.099, 0.065, 0.074, so this is finer than the 1c grid older Kalshi docs describe

other_full_field_events.title: Rocket Classic: To Make the Cut

head_to_head.note: two-golfer markets, not useful for field-wide grouping

rocket_classic_2026.verdict: Winner, Top 5, and Top 10 are ALL available for a single tournament, each with the full 151-golfer field. This is feature-parity with the DraftKings markets the grouper already uses.

winner_prices_KXPGATOUR_ROC26.caveat: captured with the tournament nearly complete -- prices have collapsed toward settlement and are NOT representative of pre-tournament pricing

market_shape.prices_note: YES contracts settle at $1.00, so yes_bid_dollars / yes_ask_dollars ARE implied probabilities. No fractional-odds conversion needed, unlike DK's displayOdds.fractional.
market_shape.naming_caution: This API version suffixes money fields with `_dollars` and fixed-point counters with `_fp`. Older Kalshi docs show integer-cent fields named `yes_bid` / `yes_ask` / `volume`. Code written against the old names silently reads undefined.
market_shape.settled_market_caution: finalized markets quote bid=0.0000 ask=1.0000. Filter on status=='active' or these will poison any probability sum.

series_tickers_of_interest.KXPGATOUR: PGA Tour -- OUTRIGHT WINNER, per tournament. 69 events. This is the DK 'Winner' equivalent.
series_tickers_of_interest.KXPGAMAKECUT: PGA To Make Cut -- full field
